cases.name: a crate with no root at all is counted as unguarded
cases.old:
if not crate_root.exists()
        or "#![forbid(unsafe_code)]" not in crate_root.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
cases.new:
if crate_root.exists()
        and "#![forbid(unsafe_code)]" not in crate_root.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
caught_by: a crate with no root at all is reported rather than skipped

cases.name: the unsafe scan looks for a use, not the word
caught_by: a tree where every claim holds passes
a crate root that does not forbid unsafe is reported
a crate with no root at all is reported rather than skipped
the word unsafe in prose is not a use
a trip count that drifted from the generator is reported
a plan line that disagrees with the prose is reported
a zone count that drifted from the CSV is reported
a client the page names and the tree does not have is reported

cases.name: the trip count is compared against the generator
caught_by: a trip count that drifted from the generator is reported

cases.name: the plan line's row count is compared too
caught_by: a trip count that drifted from the generator is reported
a plan line that disagrees with the prose is reported

cases.name: the zone count is compared against the CSV
caught_by: a zone count that drifted from the CSV is reported

cases.name: a named client must be a directory
cases.old: name for name in ("python", "go", "typescript") if not (root / "clients" / name).is_dir()
cases.new: name for name in [] if not (root / "clients" / name).is_dir()
caught_by: a client the page names and the tree does not have is reported

cases.name: the roster's phrases must still be on the page
cases.old: absent = [phrase for phrase in roster if phrase not in page]
caught_by: a claim the page has stopped making is reported
